# Desktop example cards cut their caption, and the cover shows through

## Context

Friday's gate read on #21140 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)) did not pass. Both cold readers named finding 4: captions are "cut mid-claim (`row-…`, `tree grid,…`, `names what is wron…`), and the screenshot's text shows through behind them". No lane has owned the card since the Shell (#21325) closed, and Maryam listed the finding as unowned at 14:36Z. Ada takes it for the Sun 22 Nov 17:00Z lock, so it carries no contributor labels.

## The Problem

On desktop, a card whose container is at most 520 px wide shows one line of its caption (`.portal-example-feature`). That is every card except a lead card from 844 to 1440 px. Nothing on desktop shows the rest of the line: hover and focus open the action line, not the caption, and only a tapped phone card unclamps it. A desktop visitor cannot read the claim the card makes.

Measured on `dev` at `099ce4c778`, dark theme:

| Page | Viewport | Captions cut | Cut with a two-line clamp | Clear cover, now → two lines (guard) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start here | 1440 × 900 | 6 of 12 | 0 | 0.565 → 0.473 (0.45) |
| Start here | 1366 × 768 | 4 of 12 | 0 | 0.696 → 0.631 |
| Start here | 1280 × 720 | 4 of 12 | 0 | 0.667 → 0.596 |
| Start here | 844 × 390 | 4 of 12 | 0 | 0.696 → 0.632 |
| all 22 example routes | 1440 × 900 | 59 of 101 card views | 6 | min 0.473 |

The six still cut at two lines have captions of 117 to 133 characters: Multi-Step Account Form, Country Statistics Grid, Sparklines, Mermaid Diagrams, `plugin.Popover` and Sign-up validation.

The scrim is `color-mix(in srgb, <surface> 95%, transparent)`, so 5 % of the cover paints through behind the copy, and a cover's white text leaves a ghost under the caption.

Instrument: an in-page probe on the local Portal (Neo dev mode, built CSS carrying both rules) over every `.portal-examples-list .neo-list-item` that has a `.portal-example-feature`. A caption is cut when `scrollHeight > clientHeight + 1`; clear cover is the spec's own `(caption.top − card.top) / card.height`; the two-line column injects `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` into the compact rule and measures again. Sample: "Data Grid: 100k Rows & 200 Columns" shows "Opens at 20,000 × 50 and scales to 100,000 × 200, row-…". Control: "GitHub Issues Grid" (43 characters) reads whole.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`: the compact rule `@container (max-width: 520px)` sets `.portal-example-feature { -webkit-line-clamp: 1 }` under the note "Compact 1×1 cards keep resting copy tight so clear cover stays above 45 % even with a group badge" (#21325, `458a00c49a`). The later `@media (max-width: 600px)` block sets the phone's own one-line clamp, with a tapped card that unclamps everything.
- The scrim token at the top of the file came with #21119 (`e338e1ae4a`), together with the caption's note "The scrim is solid behind every line of text and fades only inside the top padding".
- Guards in `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`: `expectCardLayout` (clear cover ≥ 0.45, ≥ 0.3 at phone widths) and `expectCaptionContrast` (≥ 4.5 against the rendered paint).

Design authority: #21119's Contract Ledger, "a proof line of more than two lines is cut with an ellipsis and stays whole in the DOM", and #20724's selected treatment, "keep the text region opaque". The compact rule's constraint (45 % clear cover) is kept.

## The Fix

1. In the compact rule, `.portal-example-feature` clamps at two lines. The phone block keeps its one line.
2. The scrim token becomes the opaque surface. The fade stays inside the top padding.
3. `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`: the Start here test asserts, above 600 px, that no caption is cut at rest, and `expectCaptionContrast` asserts that a pixel in the caption's bottom padding is the surface colour.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] At 1440 × 900 and 844 × 390, in both themes, every Start here caption reads whole at rest. The new assertion is red on `dev` and green at head.
- [ ] A pixel in the caption's bottom padding equals the surface colour on the Start here and Grid & Table captions the spec samples. Red on `dev`, green at head.
- [ ] The existing clear-cover (0.45 / 0.3) and contrast (4.5) checks pass.
- [ ] At 390 × 844 a resting card shows one caption line, and a tapped card shows the whole caption.
- [ ] The PR carries the before and after at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, dark theme.

## Out of Scope

- The six captions longer than two lines: each group's lane shortens its own records, since `examples.json` edits collide with the lanes' batches (#21539).
- The gate read's other findings: the phone header (9), the phone's chrome (5), covers (6), counts (7).

## Avoided Traps

- Unclamping on hover: the gate reads frames at rest, and touch has no hover.
- A taller card: the 16:9 card is a guard of its own, and the caption has room inside it.
